what.text: Venezuelan refugees reside in several host countries, including Spain, Brazil, United States, Mexico, and Costa Rica.
By the end of 2025, Spain hosted 169051 refugees from Venezuela.
This reflects a large increase compared to 2006, when 20 refugees from Venezuela were recorded in Spain.

why.text: The fact pack does not contain recorded conflicts or specific events explaining the causes of displacement from Venezuela.
No opposition groups, active conflict years, or specific event titles are documented in the available data.
Furthermore, the data pack records no specific disaster hazard types for displacement events inside Venezuela.

when.text: The main displacement years identified in the data span from 2021 to 2025.
Year-end totals for refugees from Venezuela in Spain rose significantly by 2019, reaching 35243.
The number of asylum seekers from Venezuela in Spain also expanded in later years, reaching 114690 at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say what travel routes people took to reach Spain or where and how they live in the host country.
Instead, the data reports year-end totals of refugees and asylum seekers from Venezuela in Spain counted at the end of each year under UNHCR's mandate.
Data for disaster displacements inside Venezuela counts new displacement movements during each year rather than individual people.
